title: A Twilight Zone twist, but you work at a call center
author: duchy23
selftext:
I've just released The Seventh Admonition, a little mystery game I've been working on.

This idea came to me after I binge-watched a bunch of Twilight Zone episodes and then watched SNL’s “1-800-EAT-S\*\*\*” sketch. I kept thinking, what if that Twilight Zone kind of twist happened to someone who works at a call center?

So, you play as a call center employee dealing with  customers (duh). There are 20 calls, five shifts, and a mystery connecting everything.

I came up with the characters, calls, and twists by mixing ideas from various mysteries I've watched or read over the years. I won't pretend every idea came out of nowhere. The difficult part was figuring out how to make them all fit into one story.

I had the idea and the story, then asked ChatGPT and Claude how to actually build it. I was originally thinking of Unreal Engine for a more realistic look, but AI turned out to be much better (or at least more efficient; that’s how it felt to me) at stylized art than realistic, so it ended up as a stylized 3D game in Godot. For the writing, Claude (Opus 5.5) is honestly a better writer than me (I am not ashamed to admit it because I feel like it is similar to Stockfish in chess. There are levels one can beat, but like, come on, you aren't beating it after a certain level. But I planned each caller’s pattern, edited the whole structure of the character sheets, and wrote a lot of the lines myself, especially the jokes. Right now the characters “talk” in a murmur-style voice instead of real voice acting. Also, the models, sounds, and images are all generated in code.

Since there's a computer in the office, I also added arcade games and fictional social media. I figured players should have something to do besides answering phones and reading dialogue.

**The game is $2.99 on** [**itch.io**](http://itch.io)**, but the entire first shift is available as a free demo.**

The story is playable from beginning to end. I'm releasing it in Early Access because there are still bugs to fix and things I'd like to improve. I'm also planning to add voices for some characters and possibly new animations for the endings, although those aren't ready yet.

I'd really appreciate feedback, especially on the writing and whether the mystery makes you want to keep playing.

Comments are open, and I'll be reading them.

[https://dicerluck.itch.io/the-seventh-admonition](https://dicerluck.itch.io/the-seventh-admonition)
